title: When Benchmarks are Targets: Revealing the Sensitivity of Large Language Model Leaderboards

bias_targets.methodology: Shuffling the order of multiple-choice answer choices and fixing the correct answer to specific positions (e.g., always A, always B) to measure changes in accuracy and recall standard deviation (RStd).

Replacing default answer choice identifiers (A, B, C, D) with alternative common or rare symbols (e.g., $, &, #, @, or Cyrillic characters) to decouple bias to particular positions from bias to specific tokens.
Comparing model performance and selection bias across different evaluation scoring methods for multiple-choice questions, specifically symbol scoring, cloze scoring, and hybrid scoring.
